limitations: Correction: metadata_report_component wal_bytes_per_apply and apply_p50_ms measure only the inner projection, not full production local apply. See the checkpoint follow-up for matched complete-apply measurements.
Host load is uncontrolled. These are development measurements, not production capacity claims.
Cached heartbeats change the compact header in every measured apply. Full StoreRecord command wire bytes remain unchanged.
Full report reads reconstruct all observations; selected reads use a page directory. Pages bound group count, not arbitrary report byte size.
Rate-capped clients are closed loop; target rate is not guaranteed delivered traffic.
The initial one-row-per-group layout regressed full-store reads. Stable 64-group pages replaced it before final validation.
Sparse payload/clock changes rewrite compact membership plus affected pages; structural hashing remains proportional to incoming reports.
